pr.body:
Ordinary authenticated cookie+CSRF HTTP form requests include transport headers that Spring MVC adds to binding values. Strict voucher/promotion allowlists interpret those headers as unexpected business fields, preventing legitimate fixture creation. Disable header binding only in the two affected binders; retain business allowlists, validation, ownership and CSRF. Five real-HTTP tests show red (2 positive cases fail) before the fix and green afterwards, including negative scope/CSRF/header-only input cases.

Approved runner Node12 PASS; complete Notifications+Buyer cancellation Node33 PASS (includes those12). Runner unit tests17 PASS. Every136 XML report hashes, summary and raw logs verified; docs/testing/qa03-form-binding/integrated-full-run-manifest.json preserves actual source/runner identities. Historical a1da102 1994-test evidence remains separate.

TD (Voucher) and HP (Promotion/security) owner review requested. No pricing, quota, lifecycle or migration change. Integrated seed candidate #69 uses the same built artifact, separately reviewed.
